title: Social Short-form lab 2 (source of the round-2 9:16 templates)
summary: The 8 vertical comps the round-2 Social Short-form templates were built and verified in: name tag, listicle, before/after split, poll sticker, countdown, post card, highlight caption and swipe-up transition.
use_when: You want to see a round-2 vertical template working before using it, copy a comp's objects into a 9:16 piece, or re-extract a template with comp_to_template.py.
carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-27
copy_notes: Each comp except SS Swipe up has a 'Lab bg' rectangle; templates are extracted with --drop "Lab bg".
Clip ids are unique per comp (snt_, sli_, sba_, spl_, scd_, spc_, shc_, ssu_).
Place 9:16 templates into a comp formatted 1080 x 1920 first (comp.format).
Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/social_short_form_lab2.py writes the comps (cc.textw needs Pillow); apply its PRESETS with preset.apply, then edit.save.
Every comp lints 0 errors / 0 warnings; bounds_inside the safe box [61, 268, 955, 1270] passes for every object.
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-27
